messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (signal) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is this a problem with Keelwater's product that a squad could act on? Pass means yes.
Fail if the cause is outside the product (pricing, contracts, the customer's own IT, staffing), if a help article would have answered it, or if it is praise.
A feature request or a described workaround is signal.
The evidence is the title, the problem statement and up to 12 customer quotes with route and date.
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "title": "Unannounced interface changes disrupt operations",
 "problem_statement": "Staff experience confusion and processing errors when the platform's interface changes without prior notice. This forces teams to undergo disruptive mid-week retraining, leading to lost time and reduced accuracy in claims processing.",
 "quotes": [
  {
   "quote": "last week the Claims Tasks panel vanished without warning, and we had to retrain our team mid-week. We’d really appreciate advance notice and grouped updates.",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-10-11T12:56:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "We had unannounced screen changes last time and it caused confusion and delays because staff had to relearn where everything was — we really need advance notice and previews going forward.",
   "route": "onboarding",
   "date": "2026-10-22T11:44:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "we just need a bit of warning and maybe a preview before changes go live, so we don’t waste time retraining.",
   "route": "sales",
   "date": "2026-10-19T10:29:00Z"
  },
  {
   "quote": "It’s the unexpected interface changes — we keep having to retrain staff because buttons and menus shift without warning, and that’s costing us time and accuracy.",
   "route": "sales",
   "date": "2026-10-25T11:45:00Z"
  },
  {
   "quote": "The unexpected interface changes have forced us to retrain staff mid-cycle, which is causing errors in our claims and payments processing — we really need advance notice and bundled releases next time.",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-10-16T15:14:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "last week the Claims Tasks panel vanished without warning, and we had to retrain our team mid-week. We’d really appreciate advance notice and grouped updates.",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-10-11T12:56:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "we’ve been meaning to talk about how your platform’s recent interface tweaks are throwing off our team’s rhythm.",
   "route": "sales",
   "date": "2026-10-25T11:45:00Z"
  },
  {
   "quote": "we had to retrain three people just to find the new location, and someone even submitted a payment in error because the button moved. We’ve had to retrain staff because unexpected interface changes moved key controls without warning — it’s causing real errors in claims and payments.",
   "route": "sales",
   "date": "2026-10-19T10:29:00Z"
  },
  {
   "quote": "It’s not just the layout — it’s the unexpected interface changes that threw off our team’s workflow and caused delays in processing reserves.",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-10-16T15:14:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "your interface changes lately — controls moving without warning — it’s forcing us to retrain staff constantly.",
   "route": "account_management",
   "date": "2026-09-30T09:19:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "the last update moved the ‘reserves’ button — we had to retrain half the team because of that.",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-10-21T14:33:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "we’re having some trouble navigating the claims module after the last update — things aren’t where we left them.",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-10-16T15:14:00+00:00"
  }
 ]
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "The claim is that unannounced interface changes (e.g., the Claims Tasks panel vanishing, the 'reserves' button moving) disrupt operations and force mid-week retraining, causing processing errors. Multiple quotes across support, sales, onboarding, and account management routes consistently describe the same product-side problem: changes ship without advance notice or previews, and customers explicitly request bundled releases and warnings. This is not a pricing, contract, or customer-IT issue, and no help article would resolve the lack of release communication. A squad could act on it (e.g., release notes, in-app change previews, grouped updates).","verdict": "pass"}
